title: Scania XT SERIES 620 CUSTOM BUILT Heavy Duty FUPS Compliant Road Train powder coated Bullbar #36
description: Scania XT 620 high tensile aluminium FUPS approved Bullbar. Heavy duty end plates plus backing plate made of 25mm thick high tensile aluminium giving clear access for the headlight, heavy duty inner box uprights and 76mm high tensile aluminium tubing. Reversible Road Train signs on aluminium plates plus hinged fold down Over Size signs. Powder Coated black to customer spec, a choice of colours is available. The large opening in the lower bar allows the AEB (Advanced Emergency Brake) and the ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) to operate without any interference from the cab protection awarded by the Bullbar. Heavy duty backing plate with removable tow pin.
